sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:20

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:20:1
items.html: “Matei ve Lo Matei.” These two Behinot are called Hitpashtut and Histalkut, by which the four Behinot. This refers to the four Otiot of the Name HaVaYaH. This is because these two Behinot of Hitpashtut and Histalkut de Hitpashtut Aleph de Akudim that he introduced above (item 19) are the two Otiot Yod, Hey of HaVaYaH. These two Behinot of Hitpashtut and Histalkut in Hitpashtut Bet de Akudim, called Matei ve Lo Matei, are the two Otiot Vav, Hey of HaVaYaH.
